title: data/index.json
description: The batch index — the ONLY file in data/ that is appended/modified after a batch is written (batches themselves are append-only, immutable, hash-anchored; DESIGN §2.2, BRIEF §4). Site build reads this to enumerate batches. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme/design name index.json but do not enumerate its fields; the shape below is this contract's design. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.1.0. This is the FILE-level schema_version (structured $comment), the uniform source the lock-population loop (DATA-LAYOUT §4) reads across all eleven schema files. Distinct from the schema_version DATA property below, which index.json INSTANCES carry to declare which index schema they conform to; the two should agree.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the index schema this file conforms to.

batches.description: One entry per batch, append-only. Presentation default order is by id (which begins with the date), never a ranking (DESIGN §4.4).

id.description: Batch id = date + event slug, e.g. '2026-08-01--gpt-6-launch' (DESIGN §2.2). Matches data/batches/<id>/ directory.

event.description: Human event slug that motivated the batch (event-driven runs, DESIGN §6).

manifest_hash.description: Lowercase-hex manifest_hash of this batch (scheme §1.2). The immutability anchor — appears in the lock and is user-verifiable (DESIGN §3.2 methodology).

n_configs.description: Number of configs in this batch (len(manifest.config_ids)).

variants.description: Prompt variants present in this batch (scheme §9).

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the batch was indexed. Presentational only — NOT part of any verify hash (scheme §0: non-deterministic observations excluded from verify hashes).

merged_into.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.1.0): id of the batch this batch's configs were physically merged into (dev-batch workflow only). Site enumeration hides merged batches from the switcher; the data stays on disk append-only. Absent for live/unmerged batches.
